extDescription.message: Tells the HomeFocus app on this PC which website is in your active tab. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

connectedText.message: Websites in your active tab are counted in HomeFocus.

waitingText.message: Confirm the connection in the HomeFocus window on your PC.

deniedText.message: HomeFocus declined this browser. You can ask again in a few minutes.

offlineText.message: Start HomeFocus on this PC; the extension connects by itself.

footer.message: Only the website's domain goes to the HomeFocus app on this PC. Nothing is sent to the internet.
